name: 공참조 체인 분석
description: 조사합니다 상호참조 해상도 chains 식별하기 위해 AI 생성 text through abnormal entity tracking and pronominal reference 패턴.
useCase: 일관성 없거나 지나치게 단순화된 개체 참조 사슬을 통한 AI 텍스트 감지
mechanism: Constructs 상호참조 chains linking mentions of the same entity throughout the text (대명사s, noun phrases, proper names). AI 생성 text often shows shorter 상호참조 chains, less complex reference 해상도s, and occasional entity confusion—where referents are ambiguously or incorrectly resolved. The method 측정 chain length 분포, referential distance, and chain branching complexity.
source: Dugan, L. et al. (2024) - RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors, ACL
algorithm: Coreference Resolution + Chain Statistics + Anomaly Scoring
parameters: 모델: neural 상호참조 resolver, Min chain length: 2 mentions, Metrics: chain density, avg distance, branching factor, Text min: 200 words
strengths:
• Captures deep discourse-level 일관성
